# Vendored dependencies

TypeScript 5.8.3, Copyright Microsoft Corporation. Apache-2.0.
The unmodified npm distribution is included so application archaeology and
source syntax validation work offline. See typescript/LICENSE.txt and
ThirdPartyNoticeText.txt. No font files are redistributed.

This pinned compiler is a tested build-tool dependency, not a statement that
5.8.3 is the newest release. Host applications keep their own TypeScript and
React versions; run their own CI before merging generated source changes.
